svg.title: Six Core Seats, Eight at Scaled Capacity
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod-seats; chart type: org_architecture; title: Six Core Seats, Eight at Scaled Capacity; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 2 FT + 4 C; Scaled Small-Team: 3 FT + 5 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person in the eight-person scaled architecture. The first six seats form the core pod; the final two are scaled additions. FT means full-time and C means contractor, not a full-time-equivalent commitment. Contractor hours and local loaded payroll must fit the modeled cost envelopes.; caption: The same six-person core supports canonical $250,000 and $1,025,000 gross-revenue scenarios. The $1,800,000 scaled scenario uses eight people; automation does not remove technical accountability.; stages: label: Core FT 1: Commercial lead; value: One core full-time seat | Buying and sales; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own demand qualification, acquisition ceilings, written sale terms, contribution estimates, and aged-stock decisions. Review title exceptions with the relevant specialist and keep commercial urgency separate from technical release.; label: Core FT 2: Operations lead; value: One core full-time seat | Inventory and records; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own receiving quarantine, serial-level inventory tracking, service-history indexing, cost allocation, documentation completeness, and buyer acceptance scheduling. Reconcile physical assets against the inventory ledger every week.; label: Core C 1: Biomedical specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Testing and repair; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform model-qualified inspection, repair planning, calibration checks, functional testing, and signed technical findings. Escalate unavailable parts or unsupported software before the commercial lead commits acquisition funds.; label: Core C 2: Decontamination technician; value: One core contractor seat | Biological controls; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply device-compatible cleaning and decontamination procedures, document process conditions, and flag inaccessible contamination. Coordinate occupational exposure controls and never equate clean appearance with completed decontamination.; label: Core C 3: Specialist freight coordinator; value: One core contractor seat | Packing and delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Arrange shock-sensitive packing, carrier selection, declared value, transit evidence, receiving appointments, and damage claims. Verify lift access, power requirements, and installation responsibilities before dispatch.; label: Core C 4: Data and documentation specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Media and traceability; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map storage locations, perform authorized sanitization and verification, preserve permitted service evidence, and assemble release packets. Escalate device-specific regulatory questions for qualified review rather than inventing certifications.; label: Scaled FT 3: Account and inventory planner; value: One additional full-time seat | Scaled scenario only; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own recurring buyer accounts, replenishment forecasts, site readiness follow-up, and aging reviews at the $1,800,000 gross-revenue scenario. Add capacity against measured workload and funded payroll, not a revenue aspiration alone.; label: Scaled C 5: Additional field biomed specialist; value: One additional contractor seat | Scaled scenario only; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Provide additional qualified bench or installation capacity when test queues and geography exceed the core specialist's coverage. Maintain the same instrument calibration, evidence standards, and serial-level accountability.

text.title: Six Core Seats, Eight at Scaled Capacity
text.tspan: Six Core Seats, Eight at Scaled Capacity

text.title: operating_framework

circle.title: label: Core FT 1: Commercial lead; value: One core full-time seat | Buying and sales; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own demand qualification, acquisition ceilings, written sale terms, contribution estimates, and aged-stock decisions. Review title exceptions with the relevant specialist and keep commercial urgency separate from technical release.

text.title: Core FT 1: Commercial lead

Own demand qualification, acquisition ceilings, written sale terms, contribution estimates, and aged-stock decisions. Review title exceptions with the relevant specialist and keep commercial urgency separate from technical release.

circle.title: label: Core FT 2: Operations lead; value: One core full-time seat | Inventory and records; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own receiving quarantine, serial-level inventory tracking, service-history indexing, cost allocation, documentation completeness, and buyer acceptance scheduling. Reconcile physical assets against the inventory ledger every week.

text.title: Core FT 2: Operations lead

Own receiving quarantine, serial-level inventory tracking, service-history indexing, cost allocation, documentation completeness, and buyer acceptance scheduling. Reconcile physical assets against the inventory ledger every week.

circle.title: label: Core C 1: Biomedical specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Testing and repair; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform model-qualified inspection, repair planning, calibration checks, functional testing, and signed technical findings. Escalate unavailable parts or unsupported software before the commercial lead commits acquisition funds.

text.title: Core C 1: Biomedical specialist

Perform model-qualified inspection, repair planning, calibration checks, functional testing, and signed technical findings. Escalate unavailable parts or unsupported software before the commercial lead commits acquisition funds.

circle.title: label: Core C 2: Decontamination technician; value: One core contractor seat | Biological controls; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply device-compatible cleaning and decontamination procedures, document process conditions, and flag inaccessible contamination. Coordinate occupational exposure controls and never equate clean appearance with completed decontamination.

text.title: Core C 2: Decontamination technician

Apply device-compatible cleaning and decontamination procedures, document process conditions, and flag inaccessible contamination. Coordinate occupational exposure controls and never equate clean appearance with completed decontamination.

circle.title: label: Core C 3: Specialist freight coordinator; value: One core contractor seat | Packing and delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Arrange shock-sensitive packing, carrier selection, declared value, transit evidence, receiving appointments, and damage claims. Verify lift access, power requirements, and installation responsibilities before dispatch.

text.title: Core C 3: Specialist freight coordinator

Arrange shock-sensitive packing, carrier selection, declared value, transit evidence, receiving appointments, and damage claims. Verify lift access, power requirements, and installation responsibilities before dispatch.

circle.title: label: Core C 4: Data and documentation specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Media and traceability; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map storage locations, perform authorized sanitization and verification, preserve permitted service evidence, and assemble release packets. Escalate device-specific regulatory questions for qualified review rather than inventing certifications.

text.title: Core C 4: Data and documentation specialist

Map storage locations, perform authorized sanitization and verification, preserve permitted service evidence, and assemble release packets. Escalate device-specific regulatory questions for qualified review rather than inventing certifications.

circle.title: label: Scaled FT 3: Account and inventory planner; value: One additional full-time seat | Scaled scenario only; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own recurring buyer accounts, replenishment forecasts, site readiness follow-up, and aging reviews at the $1,800,000 gross-revenue scenario. Add capacity against measured workload and funded payroll, not a revenue aspiration alone.

text.title: Scaled FT 3: Account and inventory planner

Own recurring buyer accounts, replenishment forecasts, site readiness follow-up, and aging reviews at the $1,800,000 gross-revenue scenario. Add capacity against measured workload and funded payroll, not a revenue aspiration alone.

circle.title: label: Scaled C 5: Additional field biomed specialist; value: One additional contractor seat | Scaled scenario only; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Provide additional qualified bench or installation capacity when test queues and geography exceed the core specialist's coverage. Maintain the same instrument calibration, evidence standards, and serial-level accountability.

text.title: Scaled C 5: Additional field biomed specialist

Provide additional qualified bench or installation capacity when test queues and geography exceed the core specialist's coverage. Maintain the same instrument calibration, evidence standards, and serial-level accountability.

Assumptions: Each numeric value represents one person in the eight-person scaled architecture. The first six seats form the core pod; the final two are scaled additions. FT means full-time and C means contractor, not a full-time-equivalent commitment. Contractor hours and local loaded payroll must fit the modeled cost envelopes.
